about.title: What is PERMITHA?
about.p1: PERMITHA (Perhimpunan Pelajar Indonesia di Thailand) is the official Indonesian student organization in Thailand under the Embassy of the Republic of Indonesia in Bangkok. PERMITHA KMITL is the chapter located at King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang — one of Thailand's leading technology institutions.
about.p2: We serve as a family for Indonesian students at KMITL: a place to ask, share, collaborate, and still feel the warmth of home in a foreign land.

ff.title: Fun Facts About KMITL
ff.card1.title: Founded in 1960
ff.card1.body: One of the oldest science and technology institutions in Thailand.
ff.card2.title: Named After King Mongkut
ff.card2.body: Named after King Mongkut (Rama IV) — the Father of Thai Science.
ff.card4.title: Ladkrabang District
ff.card4.body: A quieter and more affordable area compared to central Bangkok.
ff.card5.title: International Campus
ff.card5.body: Thousands of international students from across Asia.
ff.card6.title: Near the Airport
ff.card6.body: Only ~15 minutes from Suvarnabhumi International Airport.
